notes.title: Devlog #1 📚 The Very First Devlog
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629805/0597bf5cd59954ce484dc60fafb1336c7f0a4561.png[/img]

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ewk20lm8M2I]We announced Truth Scrapper with a beautiful trailer this month!!![/url] The response has been absolutely incredible, thank you so much for following me on another funky memory adventure. Throughout the development of ISAT, I have written monthly devlogs on Steam, talking about the making of the game. People liked them a bunch, so...

That’s right. It’s time. For the Very First Truth Scrapper devlog!

In case you just stumbled upon this, I am Adrienne, also known as insertdisc5! I am the creator of timeloop RPG [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1677310/In_Stars_And_Time/]In Stars and Time[/url], and now am working on my next game, memory visual novel Truth Scrapper. It’s gonna be a good one.

Alright! Development talk time. Where’s the game at?!?!

So, right now, I have just finished writing the script for Day 4, so I "only" have the art, code, and implementation to do for that day.
Truth Scrapper is divided in 7 days, with three different routes you can go through from Day 6 onwards. So really, I need to write and code 11 days. Which puts me at almost ⅓ through development! WOAHRGH!??!
At this point, I know where the story is going, I know what each route will consist of, etc. I just don’t know the Details. The portraits are all done, backgrounds are done sequentially for every day, gameplay is all figured out…
[b]TLDR: It’s In Good Shape!!![/b]

[b]“That was a good short paragraph, but can I have the detailed timeline of the game. Please.”[/b]
ok fine you asked for it

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629805/2680c83bc6d0704c7a0684bd76021c44bc94fb29.png[/img]
📚 this image was made so early in development, it didn't even have Betz's shibari-like pink harness

[h3]TRUTH SCRAPPER TIMELINE[/h3]

DEC 2022: I finish ISAT around NOV 2022. I get an idea. I write it down. It was going to be an RPG but nobody got time for that. Main themes and ending are here. I work on pre-production very slowly over the next couple months (because I am recovering from finishing ISAT and still gotta keep working on post-production stuff for ISAT)

JULY 2023: Ok fine let's make a renpy file and figure out if the most important gameplay thing can be done. AKA: can I make a book menu where the game remembers the choices you make, and how complicated is that gonna be for me to add to it down the line. It works and I am happy

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629805/deb0b360f5d0e5b476b2d7023313392999eb5bf5.png[/img]
📚 this image was made so early in development, it just looks very bad

AUGUST 2023: Character design. They look Not Great and character design takes me like nine months. Plot is getting somewhere though!

NOV 2023: In Stars and Time comes out. People like it I think.

MARCH 2024: I decide I need to work on something, and decide to work on that and apply for the Ontario Creates grant. This game is actually starting for realsies!!!!!!!

MAY 2024: I actually lock down character designs. 

JUNE 2024: I hire Dora, who was the producer of In Stars and Time and who rules.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629805/a340f3a610debe5612b72272825396fe9c0ca2f6.png[/img]
📚 dora and i signing our lives to one another on discord. the bond between a creator and their producer can never be broken

SEPT 2024: I work on da gaem

MAY 2025: Day 3 is implemented. We announce the game. Now we’re here!!!!

Alright, that’s it for today! This first devlog is more about telling you where the game is at, and every month you will have a whole new devlog where I can tell you about all the great things I did that month for the game. You can even comment with questions and I might answer them one day. Ok. Thank you. And as always,
DON'T FORGET TO WISHLIST THE GAME ALSO IT REALLY HELPS BECAUSE STEAM’S ALGORITHM IS MORE LIKELY TO SHOW OFF GAMES WITH A HIGH AMOUNT OF WISHLISTS THATS THE REASON WHY GAME DEVS ALWAYS ASK TO WISHLIST!!! OKAY BYE!!!!

notes.title: Truth Scrapper REAL!!!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=ewk20lm8M2I;full][/previewyoutube]

IT’S HERE!!! My next game Truth Scrapper is here it’s announced I can talk about it I am FREE.

I’ve been working on this game pretty much since I finished developing In Stars and Time, and I am SO HAPPY to finally be able to share it with all of you. I hope you will enjoy meeting Sosotte, Betz, and Amour, and I’m excited to show you even more about them and the game as development continues! Until release, I’ll be posting regular updates and devlogs, so watch this space (or sign up for my newsletter) (or both)

I know you have some questions. Here are some answers.

[h2]Is Truth Scrapper related to your previous game, In Stars and Time?[/h2]
Nope! Truth Scrapper is a whole new game, in a whole new setting! Of course, as you will discover, they will share many themes, but that’s just because I made it. I’m very grateful for the whole lot of love people have given Siffrin and the gang, and I hope in time you’ll find a spot in your heart for my terrible terrible girls.

[h2]Betz uses he/they! Are they a girl?[/h2]
The three of them are some flavor of genderfluid. They are not necessarily women. But they are Girls. To me
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629805/406d9faeb98fc29eee43a08034e1163d5f40a56e.png[/img]

[h2]What do you mean by “toxic lesbians”?[/h2]
Ok so Truth Scrappers will not contain any explicit “adult” content or graphic gore/violence (sorry). However, it IS a game about complicated, messy characters, who do not always make the best choices for themselves and others. They are NOT trying to get a good grade in therapy. I’m not sure therapy even exists where they live

[h2]Who is working on this game?[/h2]
Me (insertdisc5) <3. I made in Stars and Time, Serre, and also many comics. I am the sole full time developer, artist, and writer.
I am thankfully also supported by several wonderful partners! With me on this project are  sound designers Level Curve, composer Jess Forrest (aka CastleIF), marketing geniuses CONTINUE, and producer Dora Breckinridge, who you may know as the producer of In Stars and Time, and who loves Betz oh-so-much, so you know Betz is gonna go through some shit because I love torturing Dora oh-so-much.

[h2]Is it coming to any other platforms?[/h2]
Not as present! It is currently only planned for PC, and I am a solo, self-published dev, so I’m being mindful about my time and other resources. That’s not to say it’s off the table though.

[h2]What languages will Truth Scrapper be in?[/h2]
I would LOVE to localize Truth Scrapper in a few more languages, but I am also a big yapper and localized words cost money. We will be exploring our options throughout development, but we cannot guarantee anything!

[h2]When is Truth Scrapper coming out?[/h2]
When it’s done babey. (Don’t expect it any time soon)

[h2]How can I support the game?[/h2]
WISHLIST TRUTH SCRAPPER ON STEAM!!! This is by far one of the biggest, easiest things you can do to have an impact on the game’s success and visibility on Steam. And of course, if you like the game, be sure to follow us using the links below, and share the news… Tell your friends… Thank you… Talk to you soon…
